definitions.explanation: A burning sensation in the chest caused by stomach acid rising into the esophagus.

examples.japanese: {胸焼|むねや}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{脂|あぶら}っこい→脂っこい：14728_aburakkoi⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{胸焼|むねや}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I get heartburn when I eat greasy food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧{食|た}べすぎて、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{胸焼|むねや}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: I ate too much yesterday and have had terrible heartburn since this morning.

notes:
A burning or uncomfortable sensation in the chest area caused by stomach acid rising into the esophagus. The word literally combines ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧ (chest) and ⟦{焼|や}け→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧ (burning). Despite the English term "heartburn," the Japanese word focuses on the chest sensation rather than the heart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胸焼|むねや}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have heartburn
- {胸焼|むねや}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧: to have bad heartburn
- {胸焼|むねや}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to cause heartburn
- {胸焼|むねや}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: heartburn medicine

USAGE:
Often triggered by eating too much, eating greasy food, or drinking too much alcohol. The expression {胸焼|むねや}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (using ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, not ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) is the standard way to say you have heartburn.

RELATED WORDS:
- {胃|い}もたれ: heavy stomach; feeling of food sitting in the stomach
- ⟦{吐|は}き{気|け}→吐き気：05021_hakike⟧: nausea
